PUT /accounts/{account_id}/warp_connecto.description: Adds or updates the high-availability configuration for a WARP Connector tunnel.

config.description: Provider-specific configuration. Required shape depends on ha_mode. For `aws`, must contain `fnr_id`. For `local`, must contain `vips`. For `none` and `disabled`, must be empty or omitted.

fnr_id.description: Floating Network Resource ID — the secondary ENI that is moved between nodes on failover.

vips.description: VIPs to assign on the CloudflareWARP interface.

vips_previous.description: VIPs to clean up on demotion or version drift.

ha_mode.description: High-availability mode for the WARP Connector tunnel. `none` means HA is enabled but no provider is configured yet (newly created tunnels default to this). `disabled` means HA is explicitly turned off. `aws` uses AWS ENI move for failover. `local` uses virtual IPs (VIPs) on the local interface.
